meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和格式化 Word 文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码生成或处理 Word 文档。
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and format Word documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate or process Word documents programmatically.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以创建、读取、编辑 Word 文档（.docx 和 .dotx），包括添加目录、标题、页码、页眉、图片、表格、批注和修订，还能提取或重组文档内容。
howto.when: 当你提到“Word 文档”、“.docx”、“.dotx”，或要求生成报告、备忘录、信件、模板等专业文档时触发。也适用于提取、编辑、查找替换、处理修订或批注等操作。

say.text: 帮我创建一个带目录和页眉的 Word 报告。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个 .docx 文件供下载。

say.text: 把这个 .docx 文件里的图片替换成另一张。
say.note: Claude 会编辑文档并替换图片。

say.text: 给这段文字加个批注：费用上限太低。
say.note: Claude 会在指定位置插入批注。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, read, edit Word documents (.docx and .dotx), including adding table of contents, headings, page numbers, headers, images, tables, comments, and tracked changes, as well as extracting or reorganizing content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'Word doc', '.docx', '.dotx', or request reports, memos, letters, templates, etc. Also for extracting, editing, find-replace, tracked changes, or comments in Word files.

say_en.text: Create a Word report with a table of contents and header.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a .docx file for download.

say_en.text: Replace the image in this .docx with another one.
say_en.note: Claude will edit the document and replace the image.

say_en.text: Add a comment to this text: 'Fee cap is too low'.
say_en.note: Claude will insert a comment at the specified location.
